# Introduction

The **`kappaSizePower`** analysis (Power Approach for the Number of Subjects Required) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Sample size for an interobserver agreement study sized to reject a null kappa (kappa0) in favour of an alternative kappa (kappa1) at a given two-sided significance level and power - the power approach of the kappaSize package. Use kappaSizeCI for a target confidence-interval width, and kappaSizeFixedN when the number of subjects is already fixed.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("kappaSizePower_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::kappaSizePower(
#   data = kappaSizePower_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `kappaSizePower` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
